name: Hasted Pace
description: Step and let the quickened step cover one pace more than the leg alone could.

name: Short Fold
description: Fold the space before the forearm so a blow lands a little to one side of where it was aimed.

name: Distance Sense
description: Read how far and how fast a body is by the pace its approach takes.

name: Hasted Reach
description: Quicken the arm and lengthen its reach for one strike.

name: Folded Strike
description: Fold a short gap shut and strike from across it before the opponent sees the arm move.

name: Slow Gap
description: Stretch the space between user and foe while slowing the time in it so every approach takes long.

name: Fold Mend
description: Quicken an ally's mending at the wound while folding the ache away to a farther place.

name: Aged Fold
description: Fold a tainted wound shut around its taint and age the taint out of the body.

name: Folded Lance
description: Fold the whole distance to the target in the throw so the lance lands as it leaves the hand.

name: Stretched Gap
description: Stretch the distance between user and foe and slow time inside it so the foe cannot close.

name: Folded Moment
description: Fold the space and the moment of a barrier together and step through the fold.

name: Instant Breach
description: streams: Time + Space; fold the distance to the target shut inside a stopped instant so the blow lands before the target's moment begins.

name: Near Thread
description: Feel the nearest thread of what is likely to happen in the next breath.

name: Thread Step
description: Step to the place where the nearest thread says the blow will not fall.

name: Chosen Beat
description: Strike on the beat that the nearest thread shows as an opening.

name: Anticipated Guard
description: Hold a guard at the place where the thread shows the next blow will land.

name: Foreseen Parry
description: Turn aside a blow that the thread has shown a heartbeat before it comes.

name: Narrowed Choice
description: Slow an opponent along the one path the thread leaves them so every choice comes late.

name: Likely Mend
description: Quicken a wound's mending along its likeliest course so the scar is clean and the body keeps its strength.

name: Averted Taint
description: Age out a taint along the thread before it can take hold in the ally.

name: Directed Lance
description: Cast a lance along the thread that the target is likeliest to walk.

name: Bound Course
description: Seal the course of a foe's next three moves so that each one lands late.

name: Thread Ward
description: Hold a ward that stands wherever the thread shows the blow will fall.

name: Certain Moment
description: Strike at the moment the thread shows as certain so the blow cannot be turned or shielded.

name: Fixed Outcome
description: streams: Time + Fate; direct the thread of cause so that one blow lands at the moment the foe's fate has already chosen.
